requirement: Automotive SPICE 4.1 SWE.4.BP1 (specify the software unit verification measures): the unit measures of the software requirements.

measures.title: Access marking: one group per field, catalogue change, special groups
measures.technique: Unit test that composes the datasets of one battery per category, compares the set of field paths of every payload with the set of paths of the marking, changes one entry of the access catalogue and composes again. The system measure VM-SYS-PASS-009 checks the delivered marking at the provider's interface; this measure checks the element's composition of it.
measures.passCriteria: Passes when: every field path of every payload, by twin level and list element, has exactly one marking entry and each entry is one of the four groups of Art. 77(2); after a catalogue change only that entry differs and every payload is byte-identical; the point 2 fields are also marked for notified bodies and market surveillance authorities (once Q-017 is answered for this reading); the detailed composition fields are also marked for sorters, dismantlers and recyclers; every Technical Data field on the PartInstance twin holding a value recorded at placing or at a status change is marked legitimate interest while the same field on the PartType twin keeps its row's group; the link to the original passports carries the tier of Q-029; the state of health evaluation record is marked for end-users and third parties acting on their behalf. Any other observation fails the requirement concerned.
measures.entry: EL-DATASET built (DEV-01 closed): the dataset module that follow-up FS3 names exists with its catalogues; Q-200 answered (form of the marking); Q-017 and Q-029 answered for their cases; the fields without a stated group have one (finding).
measures.how: the test suite passportDataset.accessMarking of the reference server (to write; backend unit partition, opens no database). At the repository root, on the commit under review: run the unit suite passportDataset.accessMarking of the reference server
measures.regression: on change of the dataset module, its catalogues, a module of the reference server or sources/IDTA/; and every review

measures.title: Lifecycle status, admission and purpose rules
measures.technique: Requirements-based unit test of the lifecycle rule module: one case per row of the operation status table, the operation admission table and the purpose rule, plus negative cases.
measures.passCriteria: Passes when: a first placing gets 'original'; each operation sets the status its table row assigns; 'repaired' as a status is refused and 're-used' with the description 'repaired' accepted; a treated status without a treatment description, or without a changes description, is refused; preparation for re-use and for repurposing are admitted only from 'waste', repurposing only from another status, and from 'waste' no compliant operation other than the three; a disposal or energy recovery is marked non-compliant with Art. 70(1) and the status stays 'waste'; becoming waste sets 'waste' on the existing dataset and requires one of the three successors; the purpose comparison admits (preparation for) repurposing only with a different purpose and remanufacturing or preparation for re-use only with the same; an operation meeting the remanufacturing definition is refused as a repair; a repair sets 're-used' with 'repaired'; a repair of a waste battery becomes a preparation for re-use. Each case passes or fails on its own.
measures.entry: EL-DATASET built (DEV-01 closed): the dataset module that follow-up FS3 names exists with its catalogues; Q-034 answered with the perimeter 'application' (else the requirements move to the demo); Q-021, Q-022 and Q-703 answered for their cases.
measures.how: the test suite passportDataset.lifecycleRules of the reference server (to write; backend unit partition, opens no database). At the repository root, on the commit under review: run the unit suite passportDataset.lifecycleRules of the reference server
measures.regression: on change of the dataset module, its catalogues, a module of the reference server or sources/IDTA/; and every review

measures.title: New dataset composition rules: links, carry-over, documents, operators
measures.technique: Unit test of the new-dataset composition per operation, with one, two and three original batteries, and of the status-change performance records.
measures.passCriteria: Passes when: a first dataset with a link is refused; a re-use or repurposing dataset with zero links is refused and one with one or with two links accepted; a remanufactured dataset holds one link per original battery; each link names the operation and a link whose operation contradicts the new status is refused; the carry-over table holds (model taken over, category of the new use, no batch, own date of putting into service on or after the transition, original fields unchanged); a repurposed or remanufactured dataset without its required document kinds is refused; the original declaration of conformity is refused for a new dataset; the new dataset names the operator placing it again as responsible operator and as manufacturer; the status-change performance records, and the DIN recommended values, keep the record at placing beside every later one, each in the table's unit (resistance in ohm). Each case passes or fails on its own.

measures.title: Derived performance, recycled content and energy formulas with units
measures.technique: Unit test of each computation with the worked values of its source and its units asserted.
measures.passCriteria: Passes when: capacity fade of 45 Ah against 50 Ah is 10 %; power fade of 90 kW against 100 kW is 10 %; round trip efficiency fade of 85 % against 95 % is 10,53 %; internal resistance increase of 24 mohm against 20 mohm is 20 %; four partial cycles of 25 % count as one full cycle; the evolution of self-discharge follows the agreed formula; the recycled share of cobalt, lithium and nickel divides by the metal in the active materials and that of lead by the lead of the whole battery, both masses in kg; a footprint increase of 10,0 % is an update and 10,1 % requires a new model; the recycling efficiency is output mass over input mass in kg; the delegated-act methods (recycled content, recovery and efficiency rates) reproduce the worked examples of the stored acts. Each case passes or fails on its own; a case whose act or formula is not stored or agreed is recorded as not run.
measures.entry: EL-DATASET built (DEV-01 closed): the dataset module that follow-up FS3 names exists with its catalogues; Q-116 (the acts stored), Q-039 and the formula of SyR-LIFE-104 agreed, for their cases.

measures.title: Access marking assigns every served field exactly one group
measures.technique: Exhaustive unit test over the served field paths: the access marking built for a fixture battery is compared with the field-to-group table derived from the traced system requirements, per twin level and list element; negative cases for an unmarked and a doubly marked path.
measures.passCriteria: Passes when every field path that the element serves for a passport-bearing battery (the seven aspects and the additional models) appears in the marking exactly once, with one of the four groups of Art. 77(2) (general public; legitimate interest and Commission; notified bodies, market surveillance authorities and Commission; legitimate interest), the group equals the one its system requirement names, an instance-level Technical Data value of the individual battery carries the legitimate-interest group, and the marking validates against its own schema. An unmarked, doubly marked or differently marked path fails.
measures.entry: Q-200 has decided the form of the marking and its model and schema are bundled; the mappers of the seven aspects exist.

measures.title: Recovery targets, comparison and recycling efficiency
measures.technique: Unit test of the recovery and efficiency functions, run against PostgreSQL with the seeded rows and fixture rows: read the Part C target rows; record recoveries at and below each target for recyclings on either side of each deadline; record input and output masses of a recycling; read the Part B target rows and compare efficiencies at and below each target.
measures.passCriteria: Each Part C row cites Annex XII Part C and its point with its deadline date; a recovery below the applicable target is flagged with the row named and one at it passes; the efficiency equals output mass over input mass in %; each Part B row cites Part B and an efficiency below its target is flagged. Each case asserts its units.
measures.entry: The local substrate is up at the commit under review: a PostgreSQL 17 container with the owner role and api_app (NOBYPASSRLS), the canonical schema applied by a database script of the reference server with its grants; rows are seeded on the owner pool and the code under test runs on the api_app pool.
measures.how: the integration test suite recoveryTargets of the reference server (to write, compliance domain). At the repository root, on the commit under review: start the PostgreSQL database of the reference server; run the integration suite recoveryTargets of the reference server
measures.regression: on change of the schema of the reference server, a database script of the reference server
